title: 芒市机场至腾冲定制客运班车正式开通 — 瑞丽市人民政府
claims: A direct custom coach service runs from Mangshi Airport to Tengchong Tourist Bus Station.
The one-way fare is CNY 57 per person and the journey takes about 1.5 hours on the expressway.
Fixed departures are 09:20, 10:20, 11:20 and 13:40, with extra services added according to demand.
Tickets can be bought through the Dehong Transport Group's official WeChat account.

verification.note: Official local-government page announcing the airport coach.

claimVerification.note: 票价 57 元/人；全程约 1.5 小时.
